description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_PropertyListIterator, which extends FilterIterator and is used to iterate over property lists with optional filtering based on a prefix. It provides constructor and accept methods for filtering keys during iteration.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_PropertyListIterator
classes.description: A specialized iterator class for iterating over property lists with prefix filtering, extending PHP's FilterIterator.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the iterator with an inner iterator and an optional prefix filter.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Determines whether the current element should be accepted based on the prefix filter.
